Shark Tank India Season 2

This report captures the objectives, strategies and outcomes of the social media campaign for Shark Tank India Season 2. It shows how meme marketing, influencer partnerships and buzz-generation tactics resonated with audiences across platforms, driving engagement and awareness for the show.

Objectives

Create buzz

Create buzz about the show and entice viewers to tune in. Seeding activities helped viewers connect with the programme and increased their desire to watch it.

Exposure

Generate exposure among different age groups on social media, so the programme's following and reputation would grow, inviting new start-ups to compete for a spot on the show.

Bringing humour to trials

The show had an image of judges roasting new businesses. The meme marketing campaign aimed to add a cordial, witty context while preserving the show's serious tone.

Love from people

  • The campaign drew a wholehearted, positive response because people could relate to the content.
  • Engagement rose in the comments, where people agreed with the posts and also shared their own stories.
  • Witty responses to the judges' reactions and observations showed how Generation Z would feel in a similar situation.
  • Both individuals and professionals backed the witty, relatable elements of the content.
  • People engaged more with meme content, which left a witty yet serious impression of the show.
  • Since the campaign began, more people have learned about the programme and associate it with the humorous situations they meet every day.
